talk.name: talk
talk.task_message:
Say the following to the customer in one or two short sentences. Keep every number, date, name and quoted sentence exactly as written. Add nothing else. Do not call any tool.
Text: {{say}}

extraction_schema.name: intent
extraction_schema.description: What the customer's last message is. Values: agree = clear yes: yes, that's me, speaking, I confirm, I can pay, okay; decline = a plain no or refusal of the payment or of the offer, with no date and no amount; other_person = someone other than the customer answers (not him or her, a relative, colleague, 'he is not here'); wrong_number = says the number does not belong to the customer / wrong number; deceased = says the customer has died; robot_question = asks whether the speaker is a robot, machine or AI; scam_question = asks whether this is a scam or fraud; what_about = asks who is calling or what the call is about or why, instead of answering; other_question = asks any other question; human = asks for a human, a person or an agent; refuse_talk = says they do not want to talk, are not interested, or refuses to answer the security questions; paid = says they already paid this amount; dispute = says the debt is not theirs, they never had the product, or it was closed or paid off in the past; restructure = asks for a new payment plan or lower instalments; hardship = mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss; full_too_much = says the full amount is too much but names no amount; terms_request = asks for a discount, a waiver, a lower price or any other term; none = none of the above, a greeting such as hello, or unclear. Use none when unsure.

extraction_schema.name: date_words
extraction_schema.description: The day the customer names for a payment or a callback, in their own words (tomorrow, the 20th, next Friday, end of the month). Empty if none.

extraction_schema.name: time_words
extraction_schema.description: A clock time the customer names, in their words (eleven in the morning, 3 pm). Empty if none.

extraction_schema.name: amount_words
extraction_schema.description: An amount of money the customer says they can pay, digits only, e.g. 250 or 250.50. Empty if none.

extraction_schema.name: dob_text
extraction_schema.description: A date of birth or a part of it, written with digits and the month name as the customer said it, e.g. '14 March 1985', 'March' or '1985'. Numbers only like 03/04/1985 stay as said. Empty if none.

extraction_schema.name: digits_text
extraction_schema.description: Digits the customer says as phone digits, as digits only. Empty if none.

opening.name: opening

on_enter.text: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?

opening.task_message: Wait for the customer's answer. Do not call any tool.

answer.description: For date_of_birth: the date as YYYY-MM-DD. Callers say dates in words, the agent converts. An unreadable value is rejected with ok=false and is not counted as a wrong answer. For phone_last4: four digits.

reason.description: Required for every outcome except promise and paid. See the table in the brief.

function.name: end_call
function.description:
This is used to technically terminate the call after all the customer's questions have been answered and necessary information has been provided.
- It should only be triggered SILENTLY in the background after the customer-related workflow is complete; never mention this tool or its name to the customer.

llmConfig.systemPrompt: You are a helpful assistant. Your role is to help users with their tasks. Always be friendly and professional. You can use `end_call` tool after you say goodbye to customer to hang up if call about to finish.

workflow.system_prompt: You are the digital assistant of Freya Bank on a phone call. Speak English, one or two short sentences per turn. Say only what you are told to say. Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or any term. A recorded promise cannot be changed in this call; the customer can change it in the mobile app.
